messages:
sara: Quick follow-up to the pinning schema RFC. Idea: ‘variant coalescence' mode so the control plane can treat small, compatible variant diffs as one logical pin for routing/telemetry for a configurable window. Helps reduce churn for perf/quantization-only canaries.

mike: useful but scary re: semantic drift. how do we define compatible? eval thresholds? :thinking_face:

yun: agree on risk. require explicit compatibility signal from model onboarding (delta-accuracy < X on curated eval) and add a coalesce_score. telemetry must still expose per-variant traces.

kevin: routing needs deterministic mapping. propose new rollout metadata fields: coalesce_group_id and coalesce_window_days. also need coalesce_policy.

sara: sketch of schema additions (informal): coalesce_group_id: optional string, coalesce_window_days: optional int, coalesce_policy: enum(strict|lenient), compatibility_signal: eval_id + threshold. control plane routes to bound variants but tags telemetry with group id. after window expires we either hard-collapse or lift group by policy.

mike: tenant pins? tenant pin should take precedence. coalescing must not silently override explicit tenant choices.

lucas: agree tenant pin precedence. we can auto-suggest tenant migration when coalesce_score high (suggested_migration event surfaced in UI).

yun: ops: autoscaler implications. if coalesced variants live on different pool types (fp16 vs int8 quant), need explicit coalesce_compatible_pools list to guide routing and capacity planning.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for variant v2-quant on release/2026-03-10 :rocket:

kevin: deprecation flow proposal: phases = soft-coalesce (group routing+telemetry), notice (notify tenants + suggested migration), hard-deprecate (reject requests with recommended replacement). add deprecation_phase enum and deprecation_eta timestamp.

sara: minimal compatibility contract: model owner flags compatibility + attaches eval_id and threshold; platform runs quick diagnostic on canonical eval set per variant; if pass, platform assigns (group_id, coalesce_score) and coalesce_window starts when first member assigned.

mike: audit/compliance: must not obscure variant hash. audit logs must record exact variant hash used per inference even if grouped under coalesce_group_id.

sara: agreed. audit logs always include variant hash and routing decision. UI/telemetry surface both group and per-variant metrics.

lucas: implementation notes: small resolver change + rollout metadata extension. deterministic group id: sha256 of sorted variant hashes so control plane replicas agree. backfill should compute group ids the same way.

yun: add tenant-level opt-out: tenant_meta.allow_coalescing = false for regulated customers.

sara: next steps: i'll draft RFC + data model PR with fields: coalesce_group_id, coalesce_window_days, coalesce_policy, compatibility_signal, deprecation_phase, deprecation_eta, coalesce_compatible_pools, suggested_migration. will include example flows and UI copy. link (draft): https://go/redwood/internal/rfc/coalesce

kevin: include migration metrics in RFC: migration success rate, latency delta, cost delta, false-positive regressions where coalesced variant later regressed.

sara: will add telemetry reqs and rollback playbook if regression > threshold. targeting RFC this week. :+1:
